payload.title: kino's supply is halted by the purview guard
payload.body: Kino (cinematiclab, omp) reports three purview faults with evidence at agent://SupplyK2g, agent://SupplyK2h, agent://SupplyK2f, agent://SupplyP1 (and SupplyPlanner-6, SupplyIntegrator4): (1) subagents are judged against kino's architect contract, so implementers are refused their own unit's edits, a planner its plan records, an integrator its report; (2) every write agent://<name> is refused, in every direction, as an artifact write; (3) a refused call retried passes unjudged under the re-entry cap. 0.7.3 (loop-friction) should already skip subagents on omp and purview-routes (#42, unreleased) fixes (2) on omp; whether kino's session loaded the 0.7.3 extension is unconfirmed. (3) and the operator's ruling that the guards' judge prompts be a few precise sentences entered enforcement scope. Kino restarts p1, k2f, k2g, k2h once subagents are unguarded in its session.
